goal.vi: Mở đầu rõ ràng, dẫn người nghe qua từng phần, nêu ý chính và trả lời câu hỏi bình tĩnh.
goal.en: Start clearly, guide people through each part, give the main point and answer questions calmly.

lines: Good morning, everyone. Today, I'll be talking about our new app.
My talk is divided into three parts. First, the problem. Then, our idea. And finally, the results.
As you can see on this slide, users left the old app after two minutes. Let's move on to our idea.
The key point to remember is that users want speed. Thank you all for listening. I'm happy to take any questions.
Thanks. How much did the new app cost to build?
That's a good question. I don't have the exact numbers here, but I'll find out and email you.

phrases.say: Today, I'll be talking about our new app.
phrases.not: Today I will present you our new app.

mean.vi: Giới thiệu chủ đề bài thuyết trình
mean.en: Say the topic of your talk

why.vi: Không nói "present you"; hãy nói "present to you" hoặc "talk about".
why.en: Don't say "present you"; say "present to you" or "talk about".

phrases.say: My talk is divided into three parts.
phrases.not: My presentation is divided in three parts.

mean.vi: Nói bài thuyết trình có mấy phần
mean.en: Say how many parts your talk has

phrases.say: As you can see on this slide, sales went up.
phrases.not: Like you see in this slide, sales went up.

mean.vi: Chỉ người nghe nhìn vào số liệu trên slide
mean.en: Point people to the data on a slide

why.vi: Nói "as you can see" và "on this slide".
why.en: Say "as you can see" and "on this slide".

phrases.say: Let's move on to the next point.

mean.en: Go to the next part of your talk

why.vi: Câu chuyển ý rõ ràng giúp người nghe theo kịp bạn.
why.en: Clear linking phrases help people follow you.

phrases.say: The key point to remember is that users want speed.
phrases.not: The most important is users want speed.

why.vi: "The most important" cần danh từ: "the most important thing".
why.en: "The most important" needs a noun: "the most important thing".

phrases.say: I'm happy to take any questions.

mean.vi: Mời người nghe đặt câu hỏi

why.vi: Mời đặt câu hỏi một cách cởi mở, thân thiện.
why.en: Invite questions in a warm, open way.

phrases.say: I don't have the numbers here, but I'll find out.

mean.vi: Trả lời khi bạn chưa biết câu trả lời
mean.en: Answer when you don't know yet

why.vi: Hãy thật lòng, rồi hứa sẽ tìm câu trả lời.
why.en: Be honest, then offer to find the answer.

mean.vi: Cảm ơn người nghe khi kết thúc
mean.en: Thank the audience at the end

why.vi: Nói "thank you for listening", không có "your".

ai.name: Ana
ai.goal: understand the presentation and ask about cost

roleplay.you: Give a short talk about a new idea at work or school: say the topic and parts, give the key point, then answer a question from the audience.

turns.h: Good morning. Today, I'll be talking about a new idea. My talk is divided into three parts.
The key point to remember is that it saves time.
That's a good question. I don't have the numbers here, but I'll find out.
br: Thanks, please send it to me.

turns.h: No, that's all. Thank you all for listening.

roleplay.end: That was clear and easy to follow. Well done!
